title: This post will be helpful for anyone
author: tinder4aliens
selftext:
Hi everyone!

If you've been looking into ways to earn some extra income, you might find this interesting.

I recently came across a Reddit post by [u/garrett111398](https://www.reddit.com/user/garrett111398/) where he shared how he got into crypto and what helped him along the way.

He also has a detailed guide pinned on his profile. If you're interested, just copy his username and paste it into the Reddit search bar.
